description: Definitive guidelines for building secure, performant, maintainable apps on Cloudflare (tiny bundles, edge-first design, robust security).

Prioritize Workers & Pages. Use the official `wrangler` CLI for project scaffolding and deployment.  
✅ GOOD: Always start with `wrangler generate`.  
npx wrangler generate my-worker --type=module --ts  
npx create-cloudflare@latest my-fullstack-app --framework next

Monorepos: use `pnpm` or `yarn workspaces`.  
✅ GOOD: Centralize dependencies/build scripts.  
"workspaces": ["apps/*", "packages/*"]

Environment Variables: manage secrets via `wrangler.toml` or Cloudflare dashboard. Use `.dev.vars` for local dev.  
❌ BAD: Storing sensitive data directly in code or `.env` files that aren’t `.dev.vars`.  
✅ GOOD: Define in `wrangler.toml` and reference in Worker.  
name = "my-worker"  
main = "src/index.ts"  
MY_API_KEY = "your-api-key-value" # For non-sensitive defaults or local testing  
[secrets]  
✅ GOOD: Use `.dev.vars` for local secrets.  
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/mydb"  
dotenv -e .dev.vars -- npx prisma migrate dev

Design for edge: stateless Workers, stateful Durable Objects.  
**Edge-first Design:** Workers are stateless and globally distributed. Avoid in-memory state that needs to persist across requests or instances.
